results.reason_for_recall: Labeling: Incorrect instructions; an error in section 5.11 of the patient insert that results in incorrect medical advice.  Specifically, the labeling should read "If a severely depressed HDL-C level is detected, fibrate therapy should be withdrawn, and the HDL-C level monitored until it has returned to baseline, and fibrate therapy should not be re-initiated."
